facts.text: China's **EAST** tokamak (Hefei) sustained high-confinement plasma for **1,066 seconds** in Jan 2025, a world record; no tokamak has yet produced **net commercial energy**.
facts.plain: China's EAST tokamak (Hefei) sustained high-confinement plasma for 1,066 seconds in Jan 2025, a world record; no tokamak has yet produced net commercial energy.

facts.text: A **tokamak** confines fusion plasma magnetically in a ring; the concept came from Soviet physicists **Igor Tamm and Andrei Sakharov** (1950s). **ITER** (7 members: China, EU, India, Japan, South Korea, Russia, US) is being built at **Cadarache, France**. India's tokamaks — **ADITYA/ADITYA-U** (1989/2017) and **SST-1** (2013) — are at the **Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar**.

facts.text: UK-Japan study (*Current Biology*): the direction a **Euhadra** snail's shell coils is set by the **mother's myosin gene** (a 'maternal effect'): one S (sinistral) copy in the mother gives left-handed offspring.

facts.text: 3 Nov in science: **Alzheimer** presented his patient (1906); the **SOS** signal was adopted in Berlin (1906); the first **UNIX** manual came out (1971).

facts.text: Science snapshots: in the **Rub' al Khali** desert, 55 extinct lakes showed no human traces, so early migration needed both water and tool-making stone; **Manx shearwaters** get 'jet-lagged' flying east-west; lactose tolerance and the **sickle-cell** trait (malaria protection) show humans are still evolving.

facts.text: Fake references in science papers rose from about **6 to 23 per 10,000** papers between 2023 and 2026 (1,135 fake references in 619 of 5 lakh papers); physics had the highest rate. Unchecked **AI tools** are a main cause.

facts.text: **NIPGR** (New Delhi) found the calcium channel **CNGC13** (in xylem and phloem) carries a plant's alarm signal to undamaged leaves during insect attack (tested on *Arabidopsis* with *Spodoptera litura*), published in *PNAS*. Insect pests cause about **20%** of global crop losses.

facts.text: **Alfred Wegener**, born 1 November 1880, proposed the theory of continental drift; **Eratosthenes** was the first to calculate Earth's circumference, using shadow angles measured at two Egyptian cities.

facts.text: India's Antarctic stations: **Dakshin Gangotri** (1983, now a supply base), **Maitri** (1989) and **Bharati** (2012). India's Arctic station is **Himadri** (2008, Svalbard). Nodal body: **NCPOR**, Goa.

facts.text: **Dakshin Gangotri**, India's first scientific base in Antarctica, was built in **1983-84**, led by geophysicist **Harsh Kumar Gupta**; a documentary, *Miracle in Antarctica*, tells its story.
